verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird runs client-facing digital tools (the SCC and Term Sheet generators, a HighQ-hosted deal room, and a Legora-based AI assistant), so a privacy-posture question about user-controlled data retention and deletion is a fair one to ask. However, no evidence documents any retention or deletion controls in these tools. Its privacy legal practice and GDPR guide are advisory services, not a product capability, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
